description: Staff-only back-of-house areas for online-order fulfilment (Receiving, Pack & Dispatch, Returns), laid out around the store map's receiving desk - the stand-in for the dock, as no dock doors are mapped.

zones.name: Receiving Area
zones.note: Supplier deliveries are checked in here and put away to the racks. No receiving desk marker in this store's map; position taken from store #2910, the most similar building (152 x 92 m). Back-of-house section (50% of the back room).

zones.name: Pack & Dispatch
zones.note: Pick carts start and finish here; orders are packed, staged and handed to the delivery driver. No receiving desk marker in this store's map; position taken from store #2910, the most similar building (152 x 92 m). Back-of-house section (30% of the back room).

zones.name: Returns Area
zones.note: Items brought back by delivery drivers wait here for inspection. No receiving desk marker in this store's map; position taken from store #2910, the most similar building (152 x 92 m). Back-of-house section (20% of the back room).
